note: Jackson County TX publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county website lists no GIS zoning links. The Edna zoning map is a document (PDF) listing, not a service. The Edna ArcGIS items are parcels and land use, not zoning districts. gis.mijackson.org and gis-jcgis/share-open-data-jacksoncowi are other Jackson Counties (Michigan, Wisconsin), not Texas. Nothing for Ganado, Lolita or Vanderbilt was found.
